entries.title: Database baseline published
entries.summary: Initial snapshot of 751 accepted species and natural hybrids across 21 genera, compiled from the ICPS Carnivorous Plant Names Resource. Every accepted name on the 21 genus pages was captured, including natural hybrids and nested infraspecific taxa.

entries.title: Nine recent descriptions added to the watchlist
entries.summary: Recent species accepted in the primary literature but not yet present in the ICPS snapshot are shown as provisional entries. They are excluded from the 751 ICPS count and are promoted automatically when ICPS lists them.
